interface.title: CorroScope | Corrosion Research
interface.stage_of_work: Data analysis and record-keeping after lab exposure tests (weight-loss coupons, polarization measurements)
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn weight-loss and electrochemical corrosion measurements into corrosion rates and inhibitor efficiencies, keep them in a session experiment log that can be exported or extended by CSV import, and keep searchable literature notes alongside.

data.note: Calculators start with prefilled default values (10 g → 9.8 g, 7.85 g/cm³, 10 cm², 24 h; Icorr 10 µA/cm², EW 27.92, 7.85 g/cm³; blank 2.0 / inhibited 0.5 mm/y). Results were checked by hand: 87.6×200/(7.85×10×24)=9.299 mm/y and 0.00327×10×27.92/7.85=0.1163 mm/y both match the app. sample_experiments.csv (5 records) was a synthetic test file written by the run and uploaded via 'Import records from CSV'. The file was malformed: the notes in rows 1 and 4 ('Mild steel coupon, no inhibitor', 'Outlier: …, check cleaning procedure') contain commas but are not quoted, so row 1 has 14 fields against 13 headers. pandas.read_csv then took the first column as an index, which the table hides, so the preview and the appended rows appear shifted one column to the left. The file does have a recorded_on value in every row. The exported CSV carries these shifted rows. The import evidence therefore reflects the broken test file, not how the interface handles a well-formed CSV.

screens_never_reached: Home shortcut buttons ('Open weight-loss tools', 'Open experiment log', and by the same code path presumably 'Open electrochemical tools') do not navigate. They raise StreamlitWidgetAlreadyInstantiatedError ('st.session_state.navigation cannot be modified after the widget… is instantiated', corroscope_app.py line 184). Sidebar navigation works instead (screens/003.webp, screens/043.webp)

CSV import into an empty log: once the log is empty (on a fresh session or after Clear all session records) the 'Import records from CSV' expander and the Export button are not shown (screens/019.webp, screens/044.webp). Prior records can only be imported after at least one record exists, which does not match the README's 'import to review' use
not_done: Import of a well-formed CSV was not shown. The run's own sample_experiments.csv had unquoted commas in the notes of rows 1 and 4, so row 1 has 14 fields against 13 headers and pandas read the first column as a hidden index. The preview and appended rows therefore appear shifted one column left (screens/028.webp, screens/030.webp), and the export carries them (screens/031.webp). This is a fault of the test file, not the app. Imported IDs EXP-0001..0004 also appear to duplicate IDs already in the session (screens/033.webp); the app does not seem to check for ID collisions

Inhibition efficiency results cannot be saved to the experiment log: there is no save button on that page. Rates also do not carry over from the calculators, so I typed them in by hand (screens/018.webp)
The second electrochemical result (0.02899 mm/year) was calculated but not saved to the log. I left it out to save actions

On the Weight Loss page the rate-equation area looked blank in screens/005.webp. The page renders this equation with st.latex, so it is probably a screenshot taken before the formula finished rendering, not a missing formula. This was not re-checked. The Electrochemical and IE equations render fine

Manual records store mass loss but no corrosion rate, because the form has no density, area or time inputs (screens/025.webp). The Experiment ID field did not move on to EXP-0005 after adding a record, and the Literature Notes form does not clear after saving
I did not try the dataframe toolbar's own 'Download as CSV' or Fullscreen icons, or editing or deleting single rows (the table offers no row editing)
The About & Navigation page was never visited
